guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul Standard / Fender Telecaster / Danelectro
guitar.evidence: Jimmy Page's 1959 Gibson Les Paul ('Number One') is one of the most iconic guitars in rock history, alongside his well-documented use of a Telecaster (Stairway to Heaven solo) and Danelectro for alternate tunings.

tone.target: dark psychedelic blues-rock with wah, violin-like sustain, and volume swells
tone.profile: dark psychedelic blues-rock with wah, violin-like sustain, and volume swells
tone.summary: A vintage Marshall/Plexi style chain featuring a Wah pedal for rhythmic phrasing, followed by a boost/OD to enhance the core tone, and utilizing chorus/delay/room effects to achieve bowed, sustained lead textures.
corrections: Add bowed sustain and swell texture

rig.name: Led Zeppelin - Dazed And Confused - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and sustain artifacts.
Provide dark, mid-forward grit and initial saturation (Supro/Plexi feel).
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to emulate the desired Supro/Marshall Plexi voicing without modern high gain.

alternatives.model: Blues OD (if a slightly brighter tone is acceptable)

blocks.purpose: Implement the central rhythmic wah phrasing required for the song.
Act as a volume boost/swell mechanism for sustained lead lines.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used to simulate the effect of a volume pedal or swell box, enhancing sustain and dynamic range.

alternatives.model: Volume (if available in a dedicated block)

blocks.purpose: Provide the core dark drive and sustain needed for the lead sections.
blocks.gap: Using a general Distortion model to achieve sustained, mid-heavy grit without modern high gain characteristics.

alternatives.model: RAT-style (if more aggressive crunch is desired)

blocks.purpose: Emulate the classic British Plexi/Marshall voicing (UK 45/50 style) for dark mids.
blocks.gap: The UK SLP provides a vintage, mid-focused tone suitable for blues-rock sustain.

alternatives.model: AC30 TB (if a slightly more open sound is preferred)

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British 4x12 cabinet sound.
Add a subtle 'bowed' or watery sustain texture to the lead lines.
blocks.gap: Chorus is used here not for typical 80s sound, but for its slow modulation depth to simulate bowed string resonance.

alternatives.model: Tremolo (if a more rhythmic pulsing effect is desired)

blocks.purpose: Enhance the sense of space and sustain on lead phrases.
Add a natural, dark ambience to ground the psychedelic sound.
blocks.gap: Room reverb provides a less artificial decay than Plate or Spring, fitting the vintage feel.

alternatives.model: Plate (if a more defined echo is needed)

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and dark mid-focus for the psychedelic blues tone.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Vintage British 4x12 IR (e.g., AC30 or Plexi)
proposals.reason: Enhance vintage character and dark mid-focus for the psychedelic sound.
